description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it triggers.
In response, activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Azorius Chancery's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
